audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle completion text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for tabernacle erection, anointing, priestly washing/clothing, completion formula, cloud/glory filling dwelling, and journey guidance.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: On first day of first month you shall raise dwelling-place of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

modern.text: “On the first day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: בְּיוֹם הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Put there ark of testimony, and screen ark with veil.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

modern.text: Put the ark of the Testimony in it and screen off the ark with the veil.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת הַפָּרֹֽכֶת

verses.restored: Bring in table and arrange its arrangement; bring in lampstand and raise its lamps.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

modern.text: Then bring in the table and set out its arrangement; bring in the lampstand as well, and set up its lamps.

original.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: Set gold altar for incense before ark of testimony, and put screen of entrance for dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

modern.text: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony, and hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Set altar of burnt offering before entrance of dwelling-place of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

modern.text: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Set basin between tent of meeting and altar, and put water there.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

modern.text: And place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

original.text: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם

verses.restored: Set court around, and put screen of gate of court.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

modern.text: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר

verses.restored: Take anointing oil and anoint dwelling-place and all that is in it; sanctify it and all its vessels, and it shall be holy.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

modern.text: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it along with all its furnishings, and it shall be holy.

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: Anoint altar of burnt offering and all its vessels; sanctify altar, and altar shall be Holy of Holies.

familiar.text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

modern.text: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it shall be most holy.

original.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: Anoint basin and its stand, and sanctify it.

familiar.text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

modern.text: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.

original.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Bring Aaron and his sons near to entrance of tent of meeting, and wash them with water.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

modern.text: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת בָּנָ֔יו אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: Clothe Aaron with holy garments, anoint him, and sanctify him, so he may serve as priest to me.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

modern.text: And you are to clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him, so that he may serve Me as a priest.

original.text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי

verses.restored: Bring his sons near and clothe them with tunics.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

modern.text: Bring his sons forward and clothe them with tunics.

original.text: וְאֶת בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת

verses.restored: Anoint them as you anointed their father, so they may serve as priests to me; their anointing shall be for them for age-long priesthood throughout generations.

familiar.text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

modern.text: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they may also serve Me as priests. Their anointing will qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations.”

original.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֨חְתָּ֙ אֶת אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Moses did according to all that YHWH commanded him; so he did.

familiar.text: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

modern.text: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: It happened in first month in second year, on first of month, dwelling-place was raised.

familiar.text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

modern.text: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.

original.text: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Moses raised dwelling-place, set its bases, put its frames, put its bars, and raised its pillars.

familiar.text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

modern.text: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he laid its bases, positioned its frames, inserted its crossbars, and set up its posts.

original.text: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת עַמּוּדָֽיו

verses.restored: He spread tent over dwelling-place and put covering of tent over it above, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת הָאֹ֨הֶל֙ עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He took and put testimony into ark, set poles on ark, and put cover upon ark above.

familiar.text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

modern.text: Moses took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attaching the poles to the ark; and he set the mercy seat atop the ark.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה

verses.restored: He brought ark into dwelling-place, put veil of screen, and screened ark of testimony, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He put table in tent of meeting, on north side of dwelling-place, outside veil.

familiar.text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

modern.text: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָה מִח֖וּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת

verses.restored: He arranged upon it arrangement of bread before YHWH, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

modern.text: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛יו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He put lampstand in tent of meeting opposite table, on south side of dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

modern.text: He also placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle

original.text: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּה

verses.restored: He raised lamps before YHWH, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: and set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַל הַנֵּרֹ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He put gold altar in tent of meeting before veil.

familiar.text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

modern.text: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting, in front of the veil,

original.text: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַזָּהָ֖ב בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵ֖י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת

verses.restored: He burned fragrant incense upon it, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He put screen of entrance for dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

modern.text: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

original.text: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Altar of burnt offering he put at entrance of dwelling-place of tent of meeting, and offered upon it burnt offering and grain offering, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: He placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He put basin between tent of meeting and altar, and put water there for washing.

familiar.text: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

modern.text: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing;

original.text: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרָחְצָֽה

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron and his sons washed from it their hands and feet.

familiar.text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

modern.text: and from it Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet.

original.text: וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: When they entered tent of meeting and when they approached altar, they washed, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקָרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He raised court around dwelling-place and altar, and put screen of gate of court. So Moses completed the work.

familiar.text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

modern.text: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work. The Cloud and the Glory (Numbers 9:15–23)

original.text: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: Then cloud covered tent of meeting, and glory of YHWH filled dwelling-place.

familiar.text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

modern.text: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

original.text: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Moses was not able to enter tent of meeting, because cloud dwelt upon it, and glory of YHWH filled dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

modern.text: Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

original.text: וְלֹא יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: When cloud was lifted from over dwelling-place, children of Israel would journey in all their journeys.

familiar.text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

modern.text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.

original.text: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: But if cloud was not lifted, they would not journey until day it was lifted.

familiar.text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

modern.text: If the cloud was not lifted, they would not set out until the day it was taken up.

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: For cloud of YHWH was upon dwelling-place by day, and fire was in it by night, before eyes of all house of Israel in all their journeys.

familiar.text: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

modern.text: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys.

original.text: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם

translation_notes: Exodus ends with mishkan raised and glory filling it: the liberation goal of YHWH dwelling in the midst is achieved.
Repeated 'as YHWH commanded Moses' marks faithful completion after calf rupture and renewal.
Moses cannot enter once glory fills dwelling; presence is gracious but overwhelming.
Cloud/fire from Exodus 13 now rests on the completed dwelling and guides all journeys.
safety_note: The book ends with presence and guidance, not conquest or domination. Divine glory fills the portable dwelling and leads the liberated people through all journeys.
